title: Funky
description: Debug tools for me. Needs GUI.

settings.title: Demo menu buttons
settings.help: Add the demo buttons to the game's menus (Debug Tools and Credits on the main menu, Funky Tools in options). Needs Yu-Gi-Oh-RIX.

settings.title: Duel test enabled
settings.help: Stack the chosen hand cards on top of the deck at the start of a duel.

settings.title: Duel test add missing
settings.help: Add chosen cards the deck does not have.

settings.title: Duel test player
settings.help: Whose opening hand is stacked: 0 = you, 1 = the opponent.

settings.title: Duel test hand
settings.help: Card ids for the opening hand, comma separated.

settings.title: Duel test extra
settings.help: Card ids added to the extra deck, comma separated.

settings.title: Duel test deck you
settings.help: A .ydc test deck that replaces your deck in every duel. Empty = your own deck.

settings.title: Duel test deck opponent
settings.help: A .ydc test deck that replaces the opponent's deck in every duel. Empty = their own deck.

settings.title: Duel test keep order
settings.help: A test deck is not shuffled: the file's order is the draw order (its first 5 cards are the opening hand).

settings.title: Duel test browse dir
settings.help: The folder the test deck browser shows. Empty = Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\TestDecks.
